systemStatus.headline: MON SEP 7, ~7:00 AM PT RUN -- both overnight gaps from the 4:00 AM run are now CLOSED. TOAST: Sunday Sep 6 landed and it was a strong day -- net $10,559.19, gross $10,883.90, 345 orders, 438 guests, $24.11 per guest, $30.61 per order. Versus Saturday that is net +61.3%, orders +105.4%, guests +52.1%, and labor improved slightly to 24.7% of net from 25.7%. Only 22 void items and discounts at 3.0% of gross. CAVEAT: this is the GROUP email only -- the single-location detail email (checks, void dollars, same-day-last-week and 4-week comparisons, dayparts) had not arrived by this run and typically lands ~7:40 AM PT, so labor cost ($2,608.12) and discount dollars ($326.52) are DERIVED from percentages. Next run backfills. SLING: Monday Sep 7 arrived -- 6 employees, 6 shifts, 24.50 hours, 0 uncovered, 0 OT, 0 off. That is a 65% cut in scheduled hours the day after a $10.6k Sunday. One cook (Rafael Patricio), but against only 2 bartenders and 2 servers, far less strained than Sunday's single cook against eight front-of-house. WATCH: Julianna Ornelas and Harmony Willson were both auto-clocked-out on Toast Sunday night and are both on today's schedule -- confirm their Sunday hours were corrected before payroll. GOOGLE ADS: spend normalized to $24.21 (down $24.96 from Saturday's $49.17 spike). Impressions rose to 1,241 (+138) but clicks fell to 33 (-13), so CTR dropped 4.17% to 2.66% while CPC improved to $0.73. NEW AND ACTIONABLE: Brewhouse Lunch and Brewhouse Dinner now BOTH read 'All ads limited by policy' -- previously only the paused Performance Max campaigns carried policy limits. Daily conversions still show 0.00 'calculating', but Google's own weekly insight says BHC Coffee did 25 conversions this week versus 35 last, so conversions are tracking and the daily zero is lag. YELP: best channel right now and improving on every metric -- 31.7k ad impressions, 385 page visits, 109 leads, 329 clicks, cost-per-lead down to $3.46 from $3.62. Offsetting that, spend is pacing $16.72/day against a $13/day setting, wider than the $15.91 at last read. TWO YELP ITEMS CHANGED: the bonus-budget question is RESOLVED after fifteen inconclusive runs -- the settings panel rendered fully this time and there is simply no bonus-budget section in this account, so it can come off the board; and a new one-toggle setup item is open (ad text smart selection is off). TRIPADVISOR: nothing actionable, zero ad reports in 24h. CARRIED FORWARD: 5 unanswered reviews (3 Brewhouse, 2 Coffee) from the 4:00 AM run, drafts written and nothing posted; 15 unread Yelp inbox items now 8 days old and 3 Yelp reviews needing attention, both re-verified live this run. OPEN RISK: Google Business Profile management request still pending -- DAY 47.
